review_brief:
# Review

Completed the assigned native parametric build for `9d9fe128e55f` while leaving the existing base generator unchanged.

The exact canonical `all_by_size` program is the default. The nearby `right_anchor_threshold` setting selects the color-8 component nearest the separator by its rightmost occupied cell, derives that component’s area, then uses the area as a threshold before size-ranking and legend recoloring. The adapter defaults to three demonstrations, supports 2–6, qualifies the two-demo minimum, and always stores four distinct matched-input queries; the final query is a substantive 30×30 scene.

Adversarial review found and repaired three concrete defects: random rotation could make a declared horizontal line unplaceable; the first lesson allowed a minimum-column “rightmost” shortcut and a fixed threshold of 6; and an eight-connected rule fit some two-demo prefixes while changing a query. The repaired first lesson constructively distinguishes these cases, including guaranteed diagonal-only contact between separate 4-connected objects. The retained probe found no query-changing survivor across 36 seed/count/setting cases and 18 targeted rivals. Protected Racket replay covered canonical, base-generator, and parametric labels.

Authoring preflight passed with 24 parametric labels and 32 protected Racket evaluations. The causal witness changes the derived threshold from 4 to 6 and changes the final output. Public projection produced 16 one-query views; saved-file checks and 24 future/private-field invariance mutations passed. These are finite authoring checks, not universal uniqueness, owner acceptance, or training admission. No approval flags were edited.

sequential_dependency.step_a: Select the color-8 component whose rightmost occupied cell is closest to the separator, then count its occupied cells.
